record.paper: Variations on Sidorenko's conjecture in tournaments

dossier_meta.paper: Variations on Sidorenko's conjecture in tournaments
dossier_meta.statement_text: For every undirected tree, there exists some orientation that has the tournament anti-Sidorenko property.
dossier_meta.context_text: After characterising exactly which orientations of stars are tournament anti-Sidorenko (Theorem 1.11), the authors note it is natural to ask whether every undirected tree admits at least one anti-Sidorenko orientation. They confirm the conjecture for all undirected trees with at most one vertex of even degree (Proposition 1.13).
